simple.summary: כְּבָרָה (kᵉbârâh) means a sieve (as netted) First listed occurrence: Amos 9 9.

definitions.full: H3531. kebarah כְּבָרָה noun feminine a sieve (a net -like implement), Amos 9:9 בַּכְּבָרָה יִנּוֺעַ כַּאֲשֶׁר as it (corn) is shaken (i.e. sifted) in a sieve. compare Wetzst ZPV xiv. 1 ff .
